title: The Vaccine That Reprogrammed Children's DNA
hook: A FDA-approved childhood vaccine was later found to contain a DNA-modifying agent that triggered lifelong autoimmune disorders in thousands.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into deep parental fear and distrust of medical authorities, with the shocking claim of DNA manipulation.

title: The Government That Put Radioactive Rods in Children's Noses
hook: For decades, a government program inserted radium rods into children's nasal passages—to 'cure' ear infections.
why_this_can_go_viral: The image of radioactive rods in children's noses is viscerally shocking and instantly shareable.

title: The Hospital That Drained Patient Blood for Profit
hook: A hospital was caught systematically draining patients' blood and selling it—while telling them they had a 'rare disorder' requiring weekly treatments.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into vampire lore and real-world horror, with a twist of medical gaslighting.

title: The 'Natural' Supplement That Came From a Chemical Plant Spill
hook: A best-selling 'natural' herbal supplement was actually made from chemical waste swept up from an abandoned factory floor.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exploits the 'all-natural' wellness trend and reveals the disgusting truth behind the label.

title: The 'Safe' Antidepressant That Made Patients Kill Their Families
hook: After starting this FDA-approved antidepressant, dozens of ordinary people committed violent acts—including murder—with no prior history.
why_this_can_go_viral: Connects a common medication to extreme, shocking behavior, creating fear and forensic curiosity.

title: The Hospital That Let 1,000 Babies Die to Save Money on Heaters
hook: A hospital turned off incubator heaters to cut costs—1,000 premature babies died of hypothermia before anyone noticed the pattern.
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of defenseless babies and cold corporate calculation is emotionally devastating and widely shareable.

title: The Company That Sold 'Cancer Cure' That Was Radioactive Mud
hook: Patients paid thousands for a 'miracle cancer cure' that was actually radioactive mud scooped from a polluted riverbed.
why_this_can_go_viral: Preys on desperation and the 'miracle cure' narrative, with a grotesque physical component.

title: The Doctor Who Faked Alzheimer's Research for 20 Years
hook: A leading Alzheimer's researcher fabricated 20 years of data—his 'breakthrough' drug was actually just sugar pills, but it shaped global treatment protocols.
why_this_can_go_viral: Highlights how fake science can mislead millions and waste billions, appealing to both skeptics and truth-seekers.

title: The Hospital That Stored Bodies in a Broken Freezer—and Kept Billing Families
hook: A hospital's morgue freezer broke for weeks, bodies decomposed—but families were still charged 'storage fees' for their loved ones.
why_this_can_go_viral: The grotesque reality of decomposed bodies plus financial exploitation triggers disgust and moral outrage.

title: The 'Health' Drink That Contained a Rat Poison Ingredient
hook: A popular 'energy health drink' was found to contain a chemical used in rat poison—but the company kept selling it for 3 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines everyday consumption with a hidden poison, making viewers question what they drink.

title: The Government That Infected Thousands with Tuberculosis—Without Consent
hook: A U.S. government program deliberately infected thousands of Native Americans with tuberculosis to study the disease—without any treatment.
why_this_can_go_viral: Exposes a lesser-known but massive government medical atrocity against a vulnerable population.

title: The Hospital That Killed 50 Patients With a 'Magic Healing Machine'
hook: A hospital bought a $2 million 'energy healing machine' that electrocuted 50 patients to death—but the CEO blamed the victims.
why_this_can_go_viral: Blends pseudoscience, corporate arrogance, and patient death into a cautionary tale that mocks authority.

title: The Government That Gave 5,000 Soldiers Experimental Drugs Without Consent
hook: The U.S. military gave 5,000 soldiers untested experimental drugs without telling them—80% suffered permanent organ damage.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines military sacrifice, government betrayal, and medical horror in a powerful patriotic outrage narrative.

title: The Company That Buried Evidence Its Vaccine Caused Paralysis
hook: Internal memos revealed a vaccine company knew its product caused permanent paralysis in children—but they destroyed the documents and kept selling.
why_this_can_go_viral: The destruction of evidence combined with child victims makes this a high-trust, high-outrage story perfect for sharing.
